# gdb-mi-parser

Vendored from npm `gdb-mi-parser@1.5.0`, authored by Albert Lobo.
Upstream: https://github.com/llop/gdb-mi-parser
Package declares the MIT license. npm tarball SHA-512:
`8chfP5xl23TIPXni/nYy4pgFvYGAm0F0dzy9fKnE4766UU3onsDmrMYV63MyPLjnVIacjXCQpVDZbEGXzttBig==`

Local changes: single-pass C-string escape decoding with octal UTF-8 support,
preserved string whitespace, prototype-free result tuples, ESM export, repository formatting.
The TypeScript adapter bounds and validates records before invoking this parser.
